# Thomas Wenström

### Education

* Executive MBA with distinction, London Business School
* MSc, engineering, manufacturing, and management, Technical University of Denmark

Thomas Wenstrom is the Nordic lead for Boston Consulting Group's Tech & Digital Advantage practice. He has extensive experience in digital strategy and transformation, IT cost reduction, operating model, and AI, data, and analytics.

Thomas has worked with clients in many industries, particularly with consumer, energy, industrial goods, and transportation companies. He has functional expertise in digital, tech, AI and advanced analytics, and tech-accelerated business transformation. In addition, Thomas is a CIO/CDO advisor focused on turning around the performance of the tech function, covering digital strategy, IT cost reduction, and advanced analytics and AI.

Before joining BCG, Thomas was a Senior Manager, Nordic Head of Customer Excellence, at EY Advisory, and before that, a Manager at Accenture Management Consulting within Customer & Growth.
